newsitem.title: GERMANY: Indian gov't renews Schenker contract.
newsitem.headline: Indian gov't renews Schenker contract.

text.p: International freight forwarder Schenker International AG has won a five-year renewal of an international contract with the Indian government, parent company Schenker-Rhenus AG said.
The contract with the Indian Transport Ministry covers sea transport from Europe to India of freight for government projects, a statement said.
A Schenker-Rhenus spokesman told Reuters the company did not wish to reveal the value of the contract.
Schenker International has operated as a transport and logistics supplier to the Indian government continuously since 1962, the spokesman added.
"The successful liberalisation and privatisation policy of the Indian government has led to a rapid growth in the market and increased demand considerably," the statement noted.
A Schenker International special project group in Hamburg co-ordinates all activities under the co-operation.

The forwarder is part of the Schenker-Rhenus transport group, a subsidiary of trading conglomerate Stinnes AG which is part of the Veba AG group. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
